headline: House resolution to censure Rep. Cory Mills of Florida and remove him from two committees was set aside and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have formally censured Representative Cory Mills of Florida, which is an official statement of disapproval by the House. It would also have removed him from the House Armed Services Committee and the House Foreign Affairs Committee. No official summary is available, so the specific reasons given in the resolution are not described here. On November 19, 2025, the House voted to table it or send it back to committee, so it did not take effect.

who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally censured and lost his seats on the Armed Services and Foreign Affairs committees.

who_it_affects.group: Voters in Rep. Mills's Florida district
who_it_affects.how: Their representative would no longer have served on those two committees.
